current_evidence: A site-restricted search shows a 'Local Requirements and planning application Forms' hub with a page per application type: 'Full planning permission local requirements', 'Householder planning permission local requirements', 'Reserved matters application local requirements', 'Agricultural development application local requirements', 'Block plan local requirements' and 'Prior approval checklists'. This looks like the council's current local list, set out by application type. Grokbot's 'checklist-full-planning-applications' page is still indexed too. Neither page could be fetched (WebFetch HTTP 403, shared budget used up), so neither could be dated or confirmed.

issues.detail: Grokbot links one page, 'Checklist for full planning applications'. The council now appears to publish its local list as a 'Local Requirements and planning application Forms' hub with separate pages per application type (Full, Householder, Reserved matters, Agricultural, Block plan, Prior approval). Grokbot did not find or read any of these, so its link probably points to an older or partial page. This is unverified because the pages could not be fetched.
issues.evidence: WebSearch (brighton-hove.gov.uk) titles: 'Local Requirements and planning application Forms', 'Full planning permission local requirements', 'Householder planning permission local requirements', 'Reserved matters application local requirements'

issues.detail: Grokbot records '(none) - national requirements only' for Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, Change of use - prior approval and the other non-householder/non-full types. But the council has type-specific pages: 'Reserved matters application local requirements', 'Prior approval checklists', 'Advert application form page', 'Agricultural development application local requirements'. Grokbot's own docs_read also includes '/planning/heritage/listed-building-checklist' and 'planning-application-checklist-miscellaneous', so it read a listed building checklist and still reported no listed building consent requirements.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Listed building consent: 'No specific local requirements identified'; docs_read includes https://www.brighton-hove.gov.uk/planning/heritage/listed-building-checklist

issues.detail: Grokbot read the council's 'affordable-housing-validation-requirements' page (it is in docs_read), but no affordable housing requirement (for example an Affordable Housing Statement) appears under any application type. The only related item is the Viability Assessment.
issues.evidence: docs_read: https://www.brighton-hove.gov.uk/content/planning/planning-applications/affordable-housing-validation-requirements; no affordable housing row in app_type_rows

issues.detail: Seven of the 16 tab_items are link text for Planning Advice Notes (PANs) from the PAN listing page (node/15901), not validation requirements: 'Download the Farm Diversification PAN (PDF 307KB) PAN 03:', the Brighton Marina masterplan PAN, the Storage and Collection of Recyclable Materials and Waste PAN, the Food Growing and Development PAN, the Local List of Heritage Assets PAN, the External wall insulation PAN, and the energy efficiency for historic houses PAN. 'Hard copies of all PANs are available at our customer service centres.' is also boilerplate. PANs are guidance and not part of the validation list.

Several more tab_items are process text, not requirements. Three are wildlife-check how-to text: 'The check will then automatically generate a summary of results as a downloadable PDF.', 'Download and save the PDF which will contain your results...', and 'What happens to the wildlife assessment check Our planning validation team will assess...'. Two are generic: 'Standards for online submissions (file sizes and formats).' and a highway-notice how-to fragment ending 'Send to:'.

Grokbot built requirement rows from pages that are not the validation list. The Biodiversity Checklist and Ecological Survey rows come from a 2009 Word document (Biodiversity_Checklist_Sep_09), although the 2022 'Annex 5 Full and Outline Apps Biodiversity Checklist' xlsx is also in docs_read. The BNG and HRA rows come from SPD11 annexes, and the Health Impact Assessment row comes from a guidance note. Grokbot also read the heritage 'Local List of Heritage Assets' pages, including the street-lighting directory entry, apparently confusing the heritage local list with the validation local list.

Several trigger excerpts are fragments that do not say when the requirement applies. Householder Block plan / Site plan: 'to create a Site Plan Summary of National and Local Requirements See the planning application checklist...' (navigation text). Householder Biodiversity Checklist: 'They should submit this instead of the Full Planning Biodiversity Checklist.' (no trigger). Full BNG: a generic national BNG summary cut off mid-word ('...compensation for biod'). Ecological Survey: 'during the ecological survey and · what has been done...' (garbled). HRA: 'development, then Habitats Regulations Assessment screening must be undertaken.' (the condition is cut off). Health Impact Assessment: quotes NPPG ('a useful tool... where there are expected to be significant impacts') rather than a local trigger.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt values for Householder and Full planning

issues.detail: All seven Full planning rows (Biodiversity Checklist, BNG, Ecological Survey, EIA, HRA, Health Impact Assessment, Viability Assessment) are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning'. Some clearly apply more widely. For example, the Viability Assessment checklist says it is required for 'all applications where the proposal does not meet policy compliant requirements', and the 2022 biodiversity annex is titled 'Full and Outline Apps', yet Outline shows '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Viability excerpt 'required for all applications where the proposal does not meet policy compliant requirements'; docs_read 'Copy of Annex 5 Full and Outline Apps Biodiversity Checklist.xlsx'

issues.detail: Environmental Statement (EIA) is listed as a local Full planning requirement, but it is a national statutory requirement under the EIA Regulations 2017, not a local list item. The Viability Assessment requirement text (a full un-redacted plus a redacted version are required) is filed under 'Submission rules' and not linked to its requirement row.
issues.evidence: EIA excerpt 'meets the relevant thresholds and criteria set out in the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017'

issues.detail: The List date is blank and the list is marked 'Undated', so currency cannot be judged. Req. items is '10', which matches neither the 16 tab_items nor the 9 requirement rows in app_type_rows.
issues.evidence: reference_row List date null, Outdated (>2y)? 'Undated', Req. items '10'

summary: Grokbot's Brighton capture is weak. Most of the 16 tab_items are links to Planning Advice Notes or process text, the requirement rows come from SPDs, guidance notes and a 2009 checklist and have cut-off triggers, and every type other than Householder and Full is shown as '(none)'. The council appears to publish current local requirements pages for each application type (Full, Householder, Reserved matters, Prior approval and others), but the audit could not fetch or date them because the shared web fetch and search budgets ran out.
